source: Merged PRs on Chisanan232/coding-agent-environment. Entry state = first parent of the merge commit. The original change's test files are the hidden oracle. Task text describes behavior and acceptance criteria only.

tasks.task: Bug in scripts/hook-rollout.py. `plan` reports "change: none, already installed" when the installed hook file differs from the merged hook source, although `apply` would replace it (with a backup; the settings entry stays unchanged). Fix `plan` so that: entry absent -> it says it will append a group (unchanged); entry installed with an identical file -> it prints "none"; entry installed with a differing file -> it says it will replace the hook file with a backup; entry installed with a missing file -> it says it will install the file, no backup; conflicting entry -> refused (unchanged). Do not change apply, verify, rollback or the WARN/ENFORCE behavior. Add tests to tests/test-hook-rollout.py for the new states.

Bug: an installed disk-admission gate hook reports `disk-admission.py not found` because the launcher install never copies the adapter. Make scripts/launcher-install.py copy scripts/disk-admission.py and its sibling scripts/storage-integration.py into the runtime scripts directory under ~/.local/lib/coding-agent-environment/scripts/ (the fallback path that adapter_path() already searches). Do not change read_mode, the mode file, hook installation or enforcement. Add a test in tests/test-launcher-runtime.py that fails without the fix.

The host resource snapshot (`scripts/disk-admission.py snapshot`) goes stale after 120 s and nothing republishes it. Add a `refresher-plist` subcommand to scripts/disk-admission.py that prints a launchd user agent named com.coding-agent-environment.admission-snapshot which runs `snapshot --json` every 60 s: no KeepAlive, RunAtLoad true, stdout and stderr to /dev/null. It installs nothing. Add a short "Keeping the snapshot fresh" section to docs/STORAGE-INTEGRATION.md (run from the stable merged checkout, verify, rollback, failure diagnosis) and tests in tests/test-disk-admission.py. Do not change enforcement or the gate.

tests/test-resource-adapters.py::test_permanent_initial_busy_is_bounded_and_never_launches fails intermittently on a loaded machine with `AssertionError: 1 not greater than or equal to 2`. Find the root cause and make the test deterministic without raising any threshold and without changing product code or what the test asserts.

Permission-rule hardening after a security review of the permission templates. (1) Overlay template: make the asks space-free so `gcloud secrets create --data-file=/k s --project=P` and flag-first impersonation cannot match the allow rule. (2) `git worktree add`: narrow the allow to the `-b` and `--detach` shapes only, because clustered short options such as `-qBkeep` match the broad allow and can reset a branch. (3) Make the ask globs position- and quote-proof for `git*--output*`, `git*--ext-diff*`, `git*--no-index*`, `git fetch*--upl*`, and `git worktree add*-B*` / `-f*`. Document residual limits in an ADR. Keep and extend the tests in tests/test-permission-governance.py.

tests/test-hook-rollout.py is the only test file CI does not run. Add it to .github/workflows/capability-validation.yml, and make the workflow also trigger (pull request and push) on changes to scripts/hook-rollout.py. The change is additive only: do not skip, reorder or weaken any existing check.
